description: **`Test-Lib.ps1` `Invoke-Selected`: runner parameters leak into case bodies**: `harness/tests/Test-Lib.ps1` `Invoke-Selected`: the comment says every local a case body can see carries a `tc` prefix, but `$name`, `$body`, `$only`, `$repeat` and `$onStart` do not and case bodies run in that dynamic scope; rename to `$tcName` and the like, or run `$body` through `.GetNewClosure()` Why: nothing reads them today (grep), a future body reading an uninitialised `$repeat` would silently get the runner's value; in the next job that changes `Test-Lib.ps1` anyway Raised: napoleon J19 review Later 2, 2026-11-04
title: `Test-Lib.ps1` `Invoke-Selected`: runner parameters leak into case bodies
